Name: CP port of Even More Cuter Sophia
Author: SingleMaltWhisky
Description:
[size=3]I really love these outfits of Sophia made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Shiroho/mods?gameId=1303]Shiroho[/url], so I decided to port it for Content Patcher. Also works with Generic Mod Config Menu to select one of the three available eye colors.[/size]

[size=5][b]Install instructions:[/b][/size]
Just copy the folder from the .zip file into your mods folder. Just make sure you also have Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE installed.
This mod basically overwrites Sophia's sprites and portraits of that mod.

[size=5][b]Credits:[/b][/size]
- [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Shiroho/mods?gameId=1303]Shiroho[/url]﻿: For the amazing artwork of Sophia's outfits
